about_the_game:
Stand guard and use nature to your advantage with the Forest Warden Gear Set for the Security team.

Contains seven different cosmetic gear pieces:

- Forest Warden Headgear

- Forest Warden Facewear

- Forest Warden Eyewear

- Forest Warden Hands

- Forest Warden Torso

- Forest Warden Legs

- Forest Warden Feet

These items are unlocked in-game immediately upon purchase and can be combined with other cosmetic gear pieces. They can be equipped in-game in the Customization menu, which can be accessed from the Main menu.

The Forest Warden Gear Set is included in the Overrun Set Bundle.
